effective_date: # QuantRank historical S&P 500 membership ledger.
# Format: one row per ADD or REMOVE event. Sorted newest-first; the consumer
# (compute/ingest/historical_universe.py) re-sorts by date. RENAME events are
# out of scope (they do not change membership).
# Sources (per row source_url):
#   - S&P Dow Jones Indices press releases: https://press.spglobal.com/
#   - Wikipedia "List of S&P 500 companies" change-history table:
#     https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies
# License posture (per Research Report v1.0 License section):
#   - Factual list (uncopyrightable per Feist 1991 + 17 U.S.C. 102(b)).
#   - Our compilation = original work under the project's MIT license; per-row
#     citation included
# Scope (Phase 7.0 PR-0 -- full rebuild 2026-06):
#   - Complete ADD/REMOVE ledger 2020-04 -> 2026-06 (5-year backtest window).
#   - Triangulated across S&P DJI press releases + fja05680/sp500 maintained
#     CSV + Wikipedia; each load-bearing 2021-06+ event confirmed by >=2.
#   - Corrects the prior ledger: BLK->BX (+ missing ABNB)
#     2024-08-30 BLL removal (BLL->BALL was a 2022 rename; still a member)
#     consolidates KDP/UA/UAA to 2022-06-21
#     Bank) 2023 failure removal
#   - Integrity-gated: members_at() reverse-walk keeps the reconstructed
#     universe size in the S&P 500 band across every month of the backtest
#     window (scripts/verify_membership_ledger.py).
# Methodology (Hou-Xue-Zhang 2020 RFS + McLean-Pontiff 2016 JF):
#   membership_at(D) = members_at(today) reversed across ADD/REMOVE events
#   with effective_date > D.
